method.method_draft: First describe and label the diagram: it is an outer trapezoid with top vertices A,B, bottom vertices C,D, midpoint intersections E on the left side, F on the right side, central intersection O, and bottom interior points G,H. Read the drawn segments as horizontals AB, E-O-F, C-G-H-D; diagonals A-O-H, B-O-G, E-G, F-H; and outer sides C-E-A and B-F-D. Then enumerate triangles by size. Small visible triangles are AEO, AOB, BOF, CEG, EGO, GOH, OHF, and FHD, giving 8. Composite larger triangles formed by joining smaller ones are CAH on the left and BGD on the right, giving 2 more. Total 8 + 2 = 10.
